title: FROGGER RUSH
oneLiner: Hop across the road while dodging cars that keep getting faster!
mechanics: You guide a frog across lanes of moving traffic.
Cars hurt the frog on contact.
Reach the far side to score and return for another crossing.
Traffic speeds up after each successful crossing.
lose: The frog loses when hit by a car.
scoring: Each successful road crossing scores points, with bonus points for quick crossings.
